app.name: TraceHealth
app.tagline: Verified pollution reports and nearby clinic trends

common.networkError: The dashboard can't reach the TraceHealth server. Check your connection and try again.
common.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
common.serverError: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment.

login.title: Sign in to the TraceHealth dashboard
login.noAccess: This account is for the mobile app. The dashboard is for agency staff and administrators.
login.intro: For county health and environment teams. Reports appear here only after a trained verifier has confirmed them.

overview.title: Overview
overview.verifiedHint: Confirmed by a verifier and shown on the map
overview.topZones: Zones with the most verified reports
overview.signalsText_one: {{count}} place where clinic visits rose after verified reports
overview.signalsText_other: {{count}} places where clinic visits rose after verified reports
overview.noSignals: No rises in clinic visits have been detected.
overview.empty: No reports yet for these filters.

map.title: Pollution map
map.empty: No verified reports match these filters.

trends.title: Health trends
trends.overlay: Reports and clinic visits by week
trends.overlayHelp: Bars: verified reports of the chosen type. Line: visits for the chosen condition at clinics in the chosen zone.
trends.suppressedNote: Weeks with fewer than {{n}} visits are hidden to protect privacy.
trends.clustersHelp: Clinics where visits for a linked condition rose after verified pollution reports nearby.
trends.noClusters: No clusters found. Either visits have not risen, or there is not yet enough clinic data.

insufficient.baseline_coverage: Too little clinic data before the report
insufficient.followup_coverage: Too little clinic data after the report
insufficient.baseline_visits_below_minimum: Too few visits before the report to compare

notice.association: These are statistical associations between verified reports and clinic visits. They are not proof that pollution caused illness.

reports.title: Reports
reports.agencyNote: Agency staff see verified reports only.
reports.noLinkages: No linkage results for this report.

clinic.title: Clinic data
clinic.intro: Upload anonymised, aggregated visit counts: one row per clinic, condition and week or month. Files with patient details are refused and nothing is stored.
clinic.linkageDone: Health linkages recalculated: {{signal}} signals, {{none}} no signal, {{insufficient}} not enough data.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters with a letter and a number. Share it privately; the person can change it later.
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {{name}}? They will be signed out everywhere.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every decision and change is recorded here and can't be edited or deleted.
audit.subject: Record

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: Rewards for verified reports. Test payments use the mock provider: no real money moves.
payouts.confirmRetry: Retry this payout? Check the M-Pesa portal first if the reason says so, so the reporter is not paid twice.
